title: What artstyle is AI best at making for games?
author: shovelboy1337
selftext:
hello everybody, I'm working on a small game for fun, and I'm trying to figure out what artstyle I should go for.

I see people are saying that AI struggles with pixel art, so perhaps that art choice is a poor decision - what art style would you recommend? I'm very new and would love any kind of help

replies.author: shovelboy1337
replies.body: Aha, that's an interesting idea, I'll have a look

comments.author: Low-Cook-3544
comments.body:
In general AI is great at any art style as long as you train it well, but i'd be careful about talking to it for a game specifically. It often defaults to a very polished AI sloppy art character so definitely send in a ton of reference images, and ask it to tell you the exact way in which you'd have to prompt it to use the same style.   
  
Now to be specific I'd actually be concerned about pixel art because it gets granular and often times the pixels blur/are misaligned in my experience. Claymation is fun but not very game-y. I'd go for something monochromatic or anime :)

replies.author: shovelboy1337
replies.body:
Thanks for the info, yes I experience it being misaligned too, it looks nice but as soon as you scale it up it's very visible.

I'll look into those two artstyles thanks

replies.author: That1guy4226
replies.body: I made a personal tool/webpage that can you put in an ai made sprite sheet and allow you to center and align everything,  then export a copy with either a transparent or single color background. Highly recommend getting something like that built into your pipeline. I'm sure things already exist that do that but I wanted something a bit more personal for myself.

comments.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
comments.body: It can do almost anything if you create a very detailed style bible and walk it through multiple steps and processes.

replies.author: ThisGuyCrohns
replies.body: No it can’t. We’re not there yet with the technology.

replies.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
replies.body: I'm  literally doing it with my project,  it takes a series of multiple steps and iterations, and you need to do things like body studies, hand and arm studies, line-work and composition studies, and work on the piece bit by bit. It's not just saying "make all my stuff look the same", "give me the same art style as this".

replies.author: ThisGuyCrohns
replies.body: But what are you using? I’m talking about ai creating sprites literally from scratch. Making them usable for in game assets. Same lighting, same angle, same shadows wth same art style. It can only use headless tools that can create the art based on code. If you’re using it inside a platform, that’s custom ai. I’m talking about ai like Claude code cli creating art externally. It tried to use blender MCP, and it was able to connect with aseprite, alongside python specific scripts that tried drawing the objects itself. All of which was so bad, its confidence was high, which is the scary part since it can’t visually understand that it’s creating crap. I went as far as giving it a reference target to recreate, it spun its wheels for 6 hours at one time, made very little progress. Also I’m not talking about designing complex things. Literally pixel art to keep it simple, mostly 2d. It can’t even do that. So I’m curious, what are you doing? I’ve tried GPT Sol, Claude and Grok. All failed.

comments.author: Illustrious_Art_3774
comments.body: I think the people succeeding with it really have a firm understanding of the workflow and have their own custom pipelines, tools, and local environments that they've made in order to make it work. Just asking Gemini for game art is almost never going to work well.

comments.author: imnotabot303
comments.body: Unless you have some basic art skills AI can't do any art. You will end up with "slop".

comments.author: re-skob
comments.body: It's great at programmer art style

comments.author: Legitimate-Base-5333
comments.body: I've had decent success with PixelArt,  using things like PixelLab MCP.  However art is my weakest side so take it with a grain of salt

comments.author: shovelboy1337
comments.body: Thanks everyone, sounds like I'll just be buying a sprite pack and maybe create one or two images myself :D
